capabilities: Elaborate stub notes with AI rewrites
Transcribe audio, video, and image text
Enrich notes with tags, links, and references
disambiguation: Not a syncing tool; it uses AI to expand, transcribe, and organize notes.
extras: No telemetry; optional daily update check. Cloud AI and transcription send note content or audio to the chosen provider; Ollama keeps AI local. Video fallback needs yt-dlp and ffmpeg on desktop.
problem: Notes often stay incomplete, unlinked, and hard to organize, and media or web content is not searchable inside the vault.

relations.evidence: Supported AI providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and Ollama (local).
